notes:
## Fixes
- With a collection PIN set, clicking Unlock on the lock screen opened the PIN box and closed it again straight away, so there was no way to unlock. The PIN box now stays open until you enter your PIN or cancel.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
